Hello, everyone!

We hope the beginning of summer has been off to a great start for you all!

Our annual Steam Summer Sale is going on right now where you can get up to 90% off, but we also want to mention Steam Next Fest where we debuted demos for several of our upcoming titles!

We had not one, not 2, not even 3, but 4 demos to show off, and we thank each and every one of you who played them and spread the word.

For those unaware, here's a short summary of what each title is about:

Tamarak Trail is a deck-building roguelike where you'll use a customizable dice set as you battle through randomly generated trails full of loot, mysteries, and danger to protect inhabitants from the evil that has corrupted the trail.

In Lil' Guardsman, imagine you're a 12-year-old, suddenly in charge of the guard shed at the castle gate, where you decide if elves, goblins and 100+ other characters should be admitted. It's a wonderful combination of deduction, narrative and puzzle games.

Broken Roads is a narrative-driven RPG that brings exploration, strategic turn-based combat and meaningful philosophical choices to an all-new Australian post-apocalyptic setting.

Finally, in Stray Souls, enter a world of nightmares in this third person, action-horror, inspired by the classics of the genre. Fight terrifying creatures, solve mind-bending puzzles, and unravel a horrid family secret to expose the chilling truth behind your existence.

If any or all of them pique your interest, add them to your wishlist now! And don't forget to check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VersusEvil]catalog[/url] of existing titles for those glorious Summer Sale discounts!

notes.title: Versus Evil 8th Anniversary Sale Going on Now!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Versus Evil is turning 8! Can you believe it? Well, believe it because to celebrate we're having a sale on our awesome [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VersusEvil]catalog[/url] of games!

Over these past 8 years, we've had the opportunity to help put out many fun and creative games. This year saw the release of Jumpala, Hitchhiker - A Mystery Game, and Sockventure, as well as Early Access releases for First Class Trouble, Almighty: Kill Your Gods, and The Hand of Merlin. Tomorrow sees the release of our latest addition, UnMetal!

UnMetal is a 2D stealth action-adventure that pays homage to the classics with a healthy dose of humor and satire. You play as Jesse Fox, who is definitely NOT an elite commando, under arrest for a crime he didn't commit, and must escape a covert military base using his wits and fists.

Sounds like fun, right? Check out UnMetal and the rest of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/VersusEvil]catalog[/url] for anything that may interest you!

To close, some thanks are in order...

Thank you to our developers who really give it their all to bring these games to life.

Thank you to our Heralds who are the best ambassadors we could ever hope for.

And, of course, thank you to our players who are the reason we continue to strive to put out the best games we possibly can. This has been one long, crazy journey, and we're glad you're all on it with us.

From all of us at Versus Evil, thank you for making these past 8 years great. Now, go score some deals!

notes.title: Tournament 1 Results
notes.content:
The first public Jumpala tournament was a success! We had 8 participants and played 35 games over the course of 3 hours. Most of the participants were new to the game and had never participated in any of our prerelease tournaments. Even so, every player brought their best—there were [i]so many[/i] intense matches, tight plays, and narrow comebacks. I imagine the intensity will only grow stronger in future tournaments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/9bc013aee56ec5af28d7b3b7ffc3cb0e6e94dcad.png[/img]

Congratulations to [i][b]Timmcd[/b][/i] for his victory! Unfortunately, the leader of the Winners Bracket had to duck out last minute, so we didn't get to have that final match—but that's not to say Timmcd's victory wasn't well-deserved!


For those interested in the numbers side of things, here's a look at the character picks and their performance in the tournament:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/f6dd62e23f7050a1f6761e4582719319a507e0fd.png[/img]

Bommer had a strong showing this tournament, having been picked twice as often as the next-highest character. Frore and Ribbon were the least picked characters, but they had the highest point averages, and neither character lost any of their matches. (To be fair, Frore was only played in one match, but she took a 3-0 victory!) It'll be interesting to see how character picks and win-rates vary over time!

All of the tournament matches [url=https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLu8gYbQFnTwYK30D90jNCTw_4VHvzvZmw]are available on YouTube[/url]. You can also watch the final match below.

[previewyoutube=rdkzPHyIWBA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Jumpala Tournament this Saturday!
notes.content:
Think you have what it takes to be the next Jumpala Champion? Join us for our next tournament! The tournament will take place this Saturday, January 30th, at 2:30pm EST.

Sign up here: [url=https://challonge.com/tournaments/signup/cFuanLixHR]https://challonge.com/tournaments/signup/cFuanLixHR[/url]
Join our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/8ceswSK]https://discord.gg/8ceswSK[/url]

Jumpala tournament rules are as follows:

[list]
[*] In Game Options, change Stage Speed to Fast.
[*] Proving Grounds and Twilight Canyon are considered neutral stages. At the beginning of a match, all non-neutral stages are considered "locked" and cannot be chosen.
[/list]
For the first game in a set, players can choose their characters, and a neutral stage will be picked randomly. The loser of the first game can choose ONE of the following options:
[list]
[*] Change (and unlock) the stage of the next game
[*] Force the winner to change their character
[*] Change their own character
[*] Rematch with no changes
[/list]

Unless forced to change, the winner of the match must keep their character.  Once you're forced to change off of a character, you cannot rechoose that character for the remainder of the match.

If a stage was not picked, it will be chosen at random from the pool of unlocked stages.

The tournament will be double elimination, with each set being best 2 out of 3. Semifinals and Finals are best 3 out of 5.

Hope to see you there!

notes.title: Jumpala will be released on January 19th, 2021!
notes.content:
Happy New Year, everyone. Some good news to share with you all:

Jumpala now has a release date! You'll be able to download the full version of the game on January 19th, 2021! Wishlist now so that you can get it as soon as it's released.

I'm also excited to announce that Jumpala has a publisher! The awesome folks over at Versus Evil (The Banner Saga, Pillars of Eternity, Cardpocalypse) have jumped on board to help make Jumpala a success.


[h2]Changes[/h2]

The last few weeks have been spent polishing up the game for release. Dozens of bugs have been fixed, some menus and sprite animations have been tweaked, and some small gameplay changes have been implemented as well. Here are the most pertinent ones:

[h3]UI/UX Enhancements[/h3]
* Banned stages now persist between games
* Character Select now shows CPU level

[h3]Character Changes[/h3]
* Reduced Time's ultimate startup by 1 frame
* Fixed a bug where Lola's dash and slash doesn't always kill multiple players on the same platform
* Fixed a bug where Reese gets stuck when scampering at the end of a row
* Lola's ult now targets the platform she is on as well. However, it will not hit a player if they are standing in the same position (left, right, middle) as Lola.
* Cid's ult now passes through moving platforms on Abandoned Servers
* Fixed a bug where Ribbon's Steal could work on invincible players
* Lola now has a ~2 frame grace period where using Line Strike after pressing jump will still claim platforms


We're nearing the finish line! Can't wait to see you all on the 19th.

notes.title: v0.6 - New Maps, Private Lobbies, Solo Rankings, and more
notes.content:
It's time for another Jumpala update! This is a pretty big one, and probably one of the last as Jumpala gets closer to its release. Here's what's new:

[b]Solo Rankings[/b]
You can now see how well you did in Solo Mode! Once you beat all your opponents, stay tuned after the credits to get your ranking.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/da389404ccc7f01d105aa06998408725bb4237b0.png[/img]

The full version of the game will record your best stats for each difficulty.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/aa6fcd999665933c249657eb93fe04de28937423.png[/img]

[b]Three New Maps[/b]
Baron Industries - Be careful, there are a lot of dangerous lasers in this one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/0bfd54a1f0198a8f752797b665e40cec299d56c9.gif[/img]

Crystal Cavern - Watch out for falling icicles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/cd6c4e7b8b720675fda812376b13413b1ee3c6bc.gif[/img]

Arata City - This stage is narrower and a little higher than the others.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/08ef65aaf45f7fc84d40c8ddf9f4964058ba578c.gif[/img]

[b]Introducing Jenny[/b]
These stages can be a bit tougher than other stages like Proving Grounds or Twilight Canyon. One bit of feedback I've received is that some of the harder stages can be overwhelming and a little discouraging for new players (looking at you, Onclave Labs). To alleviate this, harder stages now have to be purchased with Jenny. You earn Jenny by completing matches, either in solo mode, local versus, or online. Beating solo mode rewards bonus Jenny, as does winning an online match.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/aba341fecc2ad2c486bb4a706870ea042a5830e7.gif[/img]
[i]Jenny is only available in the full version.[/i]

[b]Private Lobbies[/b]
The full version of the game now supports private matches! You can invite your Steam friends or send them a lobby code.

[b]Bug Fixes and Balance Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Stages will now be shuffled in online matches
[*] In online matches, the local player will now always appear as P1 on their screen
[*] Training mode no longer ends after death
[*] Training mode no longer stops after 200 points
[*] Decreased shift jump lag
[*] Reduced freeze duration of Frore's Ice Blast by 30%
[/list]

notes.title: New Character: Dr. Time
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pZW3RzNyToM;full][/previewyoutube]
It's finally time to introduce Jumpala's newest character, Dr. Time!

Dr. Time has the unique ability to manipulate time, without being affected himself. His special, Slow Time, will slow down time while allowing him to move normally. Use this to escape danger and beat opponents to items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/557ebaae9935e0a0fc47f8eedaaf4149631af032.gif[/img]

Dr. Time's ultimate will stop time completely, giving you a chance to move around the stage at will.  You'll be invincible for as long as time is stopped, so use this as an opportunity to claim as many platforms as you can!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/f76aceb64e179f63e44db72020aca2697bc7e095.gif[/img]

Dr. Time's time-bending abilities have an effect on his body. This means that all time-based effects, good or bad, last a little bit longer when applied to Dr. Time. For example...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/81a0dfb27df25c56c02ea06ef4a2e98f37717a04.gif[/img]

Items effects take longer to wear off. That's great! However, if you die, you'll take longer to respawn. It also takes longer to unfreeze after being frozen. Be careful!

notes.title: v0.4.3.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
This patch introduces a few small but significant balance changes:

[list]
[*] Slightly increased Frore's movement speed
[*] Reduced the number of startup frames Frore's Ice Blast
[*] Increased Bommer's Special Cost from 4 to 5
[/list]

I've been getting a lot of feedback that Frore's a little too slow to be utilized. These changes should make her feel a little more lively. You'll still have to position yourself well in order to line up your shots, but moving to a good position should be easier.

People are realizing Bommer's potential now. She can severely reduce the number points you can get in a round, and also guarantee points in a way similar to Cid—only her bomb placement is much faster. Her previous SP cost was 4, but since she'd gain at least 1 point back by blowing up a platform, it was effectively 3. By increasing her SP to 5, she fits in with other punishing characters like Frore and Lola.

Have fun!

notes.title: New Character - Reese!
notes.content:
It's been a long time coming, but it's finally time to announce a new character!
Introducing Reese, Jumpala's fastest (and furriest) competitor!

[previewyoutube=M4fOlKb_i74;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Not much is known about Reese's backstory. When he appeared at Javelin Stadium to announce his desire to compete for the championship, the judges' first question was how he gained the ability to speak—to which he replied, "If you think that's impressive, just wait until you see me in a game!"

While Reese is naturally quicker than other competitors, the contraption on his chest enables him to move at extremely high speeds.[/i]

[h3]Abilities[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/51c057d9626f28884424f388c652264044d81af2.gif[/img]
[b]Scamper[/b]
Reese's can use his Scamper ability to run on all fours, allowing him to quickly cover a lot of ground. If he changes directions while running, he'll slow down a little as he slides.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37404799/bb765fb0981d1d593153462bc6ad840347f86261.gif[/img]
[b]Hyperspeed[/b]
Reese will move incredibly quickly...it may take a bit to get a handle on the controls! If you bump into another player while Hyperspeed is activated, you'll stun them for a brief moment.

[h3]Development Updates[/h3]
[b]Balance changes[/b]
We spent quite a lot of time play testing Reese, and in the process, noticed some major issues that needed to be addressed.

To start with, we're undoing the recent change that prevented you from wagering when frozen. Those of you who watched last week's video probably saw how much of a game changer that was—it made Frore way too strong. You could be having a great round, and one wrong ice blast could undo all of your hard work.

We're also removing the points penalty for Lola's Dash N' Slash. We've found that good Lola players can hit their target 10s of time in a round, resulting in a point loss of 50 or more! The respawn penalty is punishing enough on its own.

Both of these changes give non-offensive players like Cid and Reese more room to breathe without having to worry about playing a near-perfect game.

[b]Other changes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where using Bommer's [b]Bombshell[/b] would destroy platforms that had yet to fall
[*] Lola's [b]Line Strike[/b] now locks platforms traveled across if a Lock Platform item is in use
[*] Lola's [b]Line Strike[/b] now cracks frozen platforms traveled across
[*] Mouse cursor no longer appears in game
[/list]

That's it for now! Be sure to wishlist!
